items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you remember old man Glenny Albert? [INTERVIEWER] Albert Glenny? Yeah, I remember Glenny.

ctx.x: Cause you play at 4 o'clock, you know, those dances down there all night long.
Uh... I was gonna ask a little bit more about any other bass players. Do you remember old man Glenny Albert?
Albert Glenny? Yeah, I remember Glenny.
